title: Phantom Gains: Auditing Self-Improvement Against a Measured Null
abstract: arXiv:2608.20290v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Whether a language model has improved itself is increasingly judged not by mean accuracy but by which individual problems it gains and loses. Tracking these transitions means differencing two noisy estimates, leaving them vulnerable to measurement artifacts. Auditing three rounds of rank-$32$ LoRA self-training on Qwen3-8B against a frozen control pushed through the identical pipeline, we identify seven measurement failures, each of which inverts a reported finding when its control is absent. Several are standard practice. A ledger built on a single greedy decode manufactures capability changes on an untrained model, largely an artifact of inference batching; the expansion statistic separating acquisition from sharpening assigns that same model a rate of $0.280$. translated_title: 幻影增益：对照测量零假设审计自我改进
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.20290v1 公告类型：新 摘要：语言模型是否实现了自我改进，越来越不依赖于平均准确率，而是依赖于它在哪些具体问题上有所得或有所失。追踪这些转变意味着对两个有噪声的估计进行差分，这使它们容易受到测量伪影的影响。我们针对通过相同流程处理的冻结对照组，审计了Qwen3-8B上三轮秩为32的LoRA自训练，识别出七种测量失败，每种失败在其对照组缺失时都会使报告的结果发生逆转。其中几种是标准做法。基于单一贪婪解码构建的账本在未训练的模型上制造了能力变化，这主要是推理批处理的伪影；将获取与锐化区分的扩展统计量将该模型赋值为0.280的比率。自然的阈值修复在复制中无法存活：根据冻结比较中已包含的设计进行估计，其零假设仍非零。我们用一个...
tldr: 本文通过对照冻结控制组的审计，揭示了语言模型自我改进评估中七种测量伪影，这些伪影在无对照组时会颠倒结论，并提出了替代方案以纠正标准实践中的错误。
en_tdlr: This paper audits self-improvement in language models against a frozen control, uncovering seven measurement artifacts that invert findings without controls, and proposes a replacement for flawed threshold repairs.
